rows.ARS:
Medium yellow Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: BARpris
rows.Bloom: Yellow, ages to lighter . Strong fragrance. Very double bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Parentage: If you know the parentage of this rose, or other details, please contact us.
rows.Notes: In their search for yellow roses, Rose Barni has created a rose in a new shade of yellow and in a multi-petalled, elegant flower.
